items.title: TJX (TJX) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Weigh Guidance Against Marmaxx Risks
items.summary: The analyst fair value estimate for TJX Companies has shifted from $177.63 to $172.80, pointing to a slightly more cautious price target in the latest update. This move lines up with mixed Street commentary, where bullish analysts point to earnings guidance and portfolio strength, while bearish views highlight softer Marmaxx comps, tougher competition, and near term execution risk.
